summary: Added repair failure metrics at the parser boundary, exposed repair attempt/success/failure metric events, and included per-run repair counts in the final run summary via a telemetry snapshot delta. Updated notes index and added a REPAIR-003 note.
notes: `cargo test -q` failed due to clap parser API: `value_parser!(usize).range(1..)` has no `range` method (clap version mismatch). This predates these changes.
